name: animated-video-generator
description: JSON-driven Animated Video Generator using Remotion, React, Tailwind CSS, and TypeScript

scripts.preview: npm run build:css && remotion preview src/index.ts
scripts.studio: npm run build:css && remotion preview src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run build:css && remotion render src/index.ts MainVideoLandscape out/video.mp4
scripts.render:shorts: npm run build:css && remotion render src/index.ts MainVideoShorts out/shorts.mp4
scripts.render:bojonegoro: npm run build:css && remotion render src/index.ts ReelsPadiBojonegoro out/bojonegoro-reels.mp4
scripts.render:flatvector: npm run build:css && remotion render src/index.ts FlatVectorBojonegoro out/bojonegoro-flatvector.mp4
scripts.render:dynamic: npm run build:css && remotion render src/index.ts BojonegoroJuaraPadi out/bojonegoro-juara-padi.mp4
